`GET /v1/status`: today's admission state, from the `Control` object.

info.description: Every console action has a call here. Every bakery is a private sandbox of synthetic data, wiped at the next 10:00 UTC. From a browser, the `__Host-session` cookie carries the session; from anywhere else, the sandbox's API token goes in `Authorization: Bearer` (signed-in sandboxes only; issue it in the console or with `POST /v1/sandboxes/{id}/token`). A request with a token and no cookie needs no `Origin`. Every `POST` carries an `Idempotency-Key`, a ULID; the same key again gets the first answer with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. Every error is `application/problem+json` (RFC 9457), its `type` `https://bakery.ihaveasegway.com/problems/<slug>`. Money is integer US cents; business times carry the bakery's Mountain offset, wall times are UTC with `Z`. Generated from crates/contracts: the route table and the schemas.
